div.span: - On Aisha, who reported that God's Messenger used to say:

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); font-size: 8px;

span.span: Observe moderation (in doing deeds), and if you fail to observe it perfectly, try to do as much as you can do (to live up to this ideal of moderation) and be happy for none would be able to get into Paradise because of his deeds alone. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: God's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that God wraps me in His Mercy, and bear this in mind that the deed loved most by God is one which is done constantly even though it is small." (Sahih Muslim 2818a)

div.span:
- Salvation is fundamentally grace through faith, where works are only its fruit/
evidence.

div.span: - Salvation is fundamentally by God's mercy, which manifests through God's love of righteousness and weighing of our deeds

span.style: font-size: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.b: God merits righteousness, but no one "earns" Paradise/Heaven by human merit alone (ie. without God's grace).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 311px; height: 1px; padding-top: 614px; margin-left: 203px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; max-height: 118px; overflow: hidden; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 1px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

span.span: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child.
span.b: The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them
span.span: ." (Ezekiel 18:20)
For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat. It is written:

span.style: background-color: transparent; font-size: 8px; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: 'As surely as I live, [says the Lord],

span.style: background-color: transparent; font-size: 8px; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: every knee will bow before me;

span.style: background-color: transparent; font-size: 8px; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: every tongue will acknowledge God.'

span.style: background-color: transparent; font-size: 8px; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));
span.span: So then, each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.

span.style: background-color: transparent; font-size: 8px; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: When tempted, no one should say, 'God is tempting me.' For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone; but each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 311px; height: 1px; padding-top: 614px; margin-left: 518px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; max-height: 118px; overflow: hidden; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 1px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); font-size: 8px;

div.span: God does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned.

span.style: font-size: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));
font-size: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of God. Indeed, God will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when God intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); font-size: 8px;

span.span: Whoever chooses to be guided, it is only for their own good. And whoever chooses to stray, it is only to their own loss. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. And We would never punish ˹a people˺ until We have sent a messenger ˹to warn them˺."

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); font-size: 8px;

div.span: (Quran 17:15)
